title: Flying Squid
content: Scientists at Hokkaido University have released photos of a kind of flying squid. They launch above the surface by squirting a powerful jet of water, reaching speeds of 24 miles per hour. They catch air on canard fins out front and flattened tentacles aft.-------Huffington Post:"Japanese Flying Squid's Abilities Confirmed, Speed Measured By Scientists"Previously on GJ:Alien creatures of the deepWeird deep sea creatures
